get.summary: Diagnostic identity check for a machine integration.
get.description: Returns the name, current scopes and token prefix of the integration whose bearer token authenticated the request; any valid token for an active integration works, whatever its scopes, so it is the quickest way to check that a token and the connection to TEA are working.

put.description: Publishes the list of checks a pipeline can run, replacing the integration's previous list, and returns how many checks it holds with a warning for each recommendation that would not pass as evidence settings. Needs a bearer token with the `health:checks:write` scope and the Claim/Evidence Health plugin on for the integration's account, which counts as opted in unless the deployment withholds the plugin; it addresses no case, so the integration needs no case grant. The body is `{ pipeline, checks }` with at most 200 checks, one per check name, in at most 256 KB, and unknown keys are refused. A check's `params` may be a plain object of setting name to default value, and a recommended `aggregation` may carry a `rule` that judges the combined result.

get.description: Returns the evidence settings accepted for the claims of a case whose checks came from the calling integration's own check list, which are the settings its pipeline should judge results against; settings that are only suggested or are inactive are never returned, and reading records which revision was read. Each aggregation carries its own `rule` with the pass mark in `rule.params.pass_values`, and a percentile reduction's percentile is `reduction.params.percentile`. Needs a bearer token with the `health:criteria:read` scope, View access to the case for the integration's account, and the Claim/Evidence Health plugin on for that account, which counts as opted in unless the deployment withholds the plugin.

Returns the health status of every property claim in a case that has a bound check or at least one record, as `{ claim_ref, status }` entries; claims with neither are left out. Needs a bearer token with the `health:evidence:read` scope, View access to the case for the integration's account, and the Claim/Evidence Health plugin on for that account, which counts as opted in unless the deployment withholds the plugin.

Returns the evidence settings accepted for one property claim when their check came from the calling integration's own check list, in the item shape of the case route, where each aggregation carries its own `rule` and a percentile reduction names its percentile `params.percentile`; suggested settings, inactive settings and another pipeline's settings give the same 404 as no settings at all, and reading records which revision was read. Needs a bearer token with the `health:criteria:read` scope, View access to the claim's case for the integration's account, and the Claim/Evidence Health plugin on for that account, which counts as opted in unless the deployment withholds the plugin.

Returns a page of a claim's evidence log, newest first, for a bearer token with the `health:evidence:read` scope or a signed-in person with view access to the case; the caller also needs the Claim/Evidence Health plugin on, which an integration's account counts as unless the deployment withholds the plugin. `limit` (default 50, at most 200) sets the page size and `before` (a `chain_sequence`) returns only older records; `next_before` in the response is the value to pass as `before` for the next page, or null on the last page. With `live=true`, only records that are not revoked and not expired are returned.

post.description: Appends one evidence format 1.1 record to a property claim's log and returns 201 with `{ record, status }`. Needs a bearer token with the `health:evidence:write` scope and Edit access to the claim's case, and the Claim/Evidence Health plugin on for the integration's account, which counts as opted in unless the deployment withholds the plugin. The body is the record, `claim_ref` must equal the path id, and unknown top-level fields are refused. An `aggregation` in the record may carry a `rule` that judges the combined result, and a reduction names its percentile `params.percentile`, or `p`. The first record accepted binds the claim to its check; a record naming another check is refused with 422, and a repeated `record_id` with 409.

schema.$ref: #/components/schemas/201 - `{ record, status }`: the stored record and the claim's status (`verdict`, `stale`, `stale_reason`, `stale_since`, `expires_at`, `record_id`, `timestamp`, `bound_check`, `rejected_since_last_accept`, `mismatch`)

get.description: Returns one property claim's health status, which is null when the claim has no bound check and no record; its `mismatch` field is null when the current result was judged with the accepted settings, `{ state: "undeclared" }` when the claim has no accepted settings, and `{ state: "mismatch", differences }` when the current result used other settings than those accepted now. Needs a bearer token with the `health:evidence:read` scope, View access to the claim's case for the integration's account, and the Claim/Evidence Health plugin on for that account, which counts as opted in unless the deployment withholds the plugin.

schema.$ref: #/components/schemas/200 - `{ status }` (null when the claim has no bound check and no record)

get.summary: GET /api/user/models — the session user's connections, jobs, recommended models and connection types.
get.description: Connections (never with their keys), the three jobs, the recommended model per connection type and job, and the connection types on offer.

post.summary: POST /api/user/models/connections — adds a model connection for the session user (up to 10 each).
post.description: Adds a connection and returns it without its key; a refused value is a 400, the limit of 10 a 409.

post.summary: POST /api/user/models/quick-setup — one OpenRouter key adds a connection and fills all three jobs with the recommended models.
post.description: Tests an OpenRouter key, then adds the connection and its recommended jobs; a refused key writes nothing.

put.summary: PUT /api/user/models/roles — saves the session user's chat, ranking and search jobs, and checks a search job that is new or that the caller asks to have checked again.
put.description: Saves the three jobs and returns them with the outcome of the search check, if one ran.

patch.summary: PATCH /api/user/models/connections/[id] — changes the label, address or key of one of the session user's connections.
patch.description: Changes a connection and returns it without its key; another user's connection is a 404.

delete.summary: DELETE /api/user/models/connections/[id] — removes one of the session user's connections and empties every job that used it.
delete.description: Removes a connection, its stored key and its jobs; works while the plugins are off.

post.summary: POST /api/user/models/connections/[id]/test — checks that one of the session user's connections answers and accepts its key, and lists its models.
post.description: Calls the connection with its stored key and returns whether it works and the models it offers for each job.
